title: Add commit_bead_state kwarg and early-return guard to RepositoryStorage
description: In src/agent_takt/storage.py: (1) add optional commit_bead_state: bool | None = None kwarg to RepositoryStorage.__init__ (storage.py:39), stored as self._commit_bead_state; (2) expose a public read-only property commit_bead_state returning self._commit_bead_state; (3) at the top of _git_commit_bead (storage.py:56) and _git_commit_bead_deletion (storage.py:118), early-return before any subprocess call when self._commit_bead_state is False; (4) when None, fall through to the existing _auto_commit class-level guard; (5) when True, behave exactly as today. The bead JSON write path in _write_bead is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: RepositoryStorage(root, commit_bead_state=False) returns an instance with commit_bead_state == False
_git_commit_bead and _git_commit_bead_deletion return without any subprocess call when commit_bead_state is False
commit_bead_state=True commits as before and still respects _auto_commit=False
RepositoryStorage(root) with no kwarg preserves existing _auto_commit behavior (None falls through)
commit_bead_state property is read-only and returns the stored value without mutation
_write_bead runs regardless of the flag — bead JSON is always persisted
